{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 in recent days) and model overestimates.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if last 3-5 days show upward momentum, apply a lagged correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when model consistently overpredicts (e.g., >10% above true outcome over 30d), especially if sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is stable (e.g., 0.00 for 5+ consecutive days) to avoid overfitting to noise.",
    "If true outcome exceeds model forecast by >5% and sentiment is positive, consider a 2-3 day lagged adjustment to avoid premature peak overestimation.",
    "For high volatility periods (e.g., >10% daily swings), apply a smoothing filter to reduce noise in short-term forecasts.",
    "When sentiment history shows a recent upward shift (e.g., 0.00 → 0.33 → 0.50), increase forecast weight on recent history to avoid underreacting to momentum."
  ]
}
